test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

I said to my friend, " Why didn't you answer my phone calls?"

options.text: I asked my friend why she hadn't answered my phone calls.
I asked my friend why she hasn't answered my phone calls.
I asked my friend why she isn't answering my phone calls.
I asked my friend why she hadn't been answering my phone calls

solution:
The correct answer is '**I asked my friend why she hadn't answered my phone calls.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an interrogative sentence. 
 
• While changing the narration of an interrogative sentence, we need to follow these steps
 
 
• the reported speech will start with *why*
 
• The reporting verb said is changed into asked or enquired__.
 
• The second person 'you' will be changed into she.
 
• The tense of the given sentence is present tense (answer) which changes to past tense (answered).
 
• **Didn't** is changed to **hadn't**. (past indefinite tense changes to past definite tense) 
 
 
 
• Eventually, we will get the final sentence-* *I asked my friend why she hadn't answered my phone calls.
